eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_1 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 1 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_1_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_3 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 3 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_3_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_3_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_edit_custom_name value = scope:eu5ab_template_name_input }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_5_name_id value = 6 }

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_edit_name_id value = 6 }

	scope = country

	effect = {

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_5 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 5 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_5_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_5_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_7 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 7 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_7_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_7_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_9 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 9 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_9_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_9_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_12 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 12 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_12_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_12_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_12_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_12_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_12_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_12_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_12_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_12_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_14 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 14 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_14_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_14_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_14_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_14_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_14_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_14_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_14_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_14_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_edit_name_selected value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_16_saved value = 1 }

eu5ab_gui_copy_active_template_to_slot_16 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_16_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_16 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 16 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_16_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_16_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_16_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_16_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_16_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_16_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_16_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_16_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_18 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 18 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_18_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_18_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_18_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_18_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_18_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_18_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_18_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_18_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_20 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 20 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the blank editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_blank_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_20_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_20_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_20_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_20_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_expand_scope_province = {
	scope = location
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_view_expanded value = 1 }
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_collapse_scope_province = {
	scope = location
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		remove_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_expanded
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_active_template_has_locations_in_province = {
	scope = location
	is_shown = {
		province = {
			any_location_in_province = { has_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_selected }
		}
	}
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = { }
}

eu5ab_gui_clear_location_template = {
	scope = country
	saved_scopes = { target_location }
	is_shown = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= { is_human = yes }
		has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
		}
	}
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
		eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_clear_current_template_scope = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { var:eu5ab_scope_location_count > 0 }
	effect = {
		every_owned_location = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 1 }
					has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot
					var:eu5ab_template_slot = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value
				}
				eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 2 }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot }
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					var:eu5ab_policy_id = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value
				}
				eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
			}
		}
		eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = yes
	}
}

# GUI data adapters; queue transitions and confirmations live in script.
eu5ab_gui_queue_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_1_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_2_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_3_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_4_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_try_candidate = {
	saved_scopes = { eu5ab_bridge_ticket eu5ab_candidate_building eu5ab_engine_country eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage eu5ab_engine_cost eu5ab_engine_income eu5ab_engine_profit eu5ab_engine_can_build eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue eu5ab_engine_capacity_used eu5ab_engine_parallel_modifier eu5ab_engine_rgo_count eu5ab_industry_count eu5ab_engine_replaced_building }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema } }
            AND = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } exists = scope:eu5ab_bridge_ticket has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request
    scope:eu5ab_bridge_ticket = var:eu5ab_bridge_request
    var:eu5ab_bridge_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase
    var:eu5ab_bridge_month = var:eu5ab_scan_month
    var:eu5ab_bridge_year = var:eu5ab_scan_year var:eu5ab_bridge_location = prev }
    OR = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_bridge_kind = 3
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_bridge_type = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { var:eu5ab_bridge_kind = 1
                OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_needed } has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_received } } }
        } }
            if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema } } eu5ab_retire_bridge_candidate = yes }

		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage OR = {
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage = 0 has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting }
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage > 0
        var:eu5ab_q_phase = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
} }
				OR = {
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 9 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_9_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 10 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_10_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 11 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_11_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 12 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_12_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 13 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_13_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 14 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_14_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 15 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_15_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 16 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_16_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
				}
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_done_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
			}
			eu5ab_prepare_candidate_dependencies = yes
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_done_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_engine_probes add = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait } }
			eu5ab_clear_validation = yes
			eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = yes
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_recipe_score_snapshot = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved }
					NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = yes
					eu5ab_engine_has_parallel_room = yes
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value < {
						value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
					} }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = yes
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
						eu5ab_candidate_route_allowed = yes
						eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
						eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes
						eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes }
				}
				eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed }
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes
						}
						eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = yes
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed }
							set_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_emergency } set_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2
						NOT = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
					}
					eu5ab_record_actual_profit_candidate = yes
				}
				else = { eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_ready }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_building_capacity add = 1 } }
				}
				else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_capacity_unavailable add = 1 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_pending_output add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_irrigation_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_storage_pending add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed } }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_engine_economics add = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = yes
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed } }
						scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 } }
					}
					else = {
						eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = yes
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_construction_materials add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_budget add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_cash add = 1 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed } } eu5ab_report_candidate_rejected = yes }
			eu5ab_clear_validation = yes
			eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
			}
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = yes }
		}

            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = yes }
        }
    }
}

					eu5ab_engine_has_parallel_room = yes
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value < {
						value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick

						eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes

					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes }

					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed }
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes

						limit = {
							has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes

					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_emergency } set_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_ready }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_building_capacity add = 1 } }
				}
				else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_capacity_unavailable add = 1 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_pending_output add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_irrigation_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_storage_pending add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed } }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_engine_economics add = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = yes
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed } }
						scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 } }
					}
					else = {
						eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = yes
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_construction_materials add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_budget add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_cash add = 1 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed } } eu5ab_report_candidate_rejected = yes }
			eu5ab_clear_validation = yes
			eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
			}
			# A winner can become unaffordable after another location reserves funds.
			# Exclude it for this phase and re-rank the remaining candidates after
			# approved projects settle. Every retry removes a candidate, so it is bounded.
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait }
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } }
				}
				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = yes }
		}

            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = yes }
        }
    }
}

# Timing only: never adopts a project or marks one complete. A matching single
# non-estate RGO in an unmixed confirmed record is the native duration source.
eu5ab_gui_capture_rgo_timing = {
    saved_scopes = { eu5ab_engine_country eu5ab_engine_rgo_count eu5ab_engine_rgo_days }
    is_valid = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_days exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count
            exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_timing_ready }
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss }
        }
            if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                raw_material = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
                rgo_level = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels = 1 scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count = 1
                scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_days >= 0 scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_days <= 36500
                owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev } }
            }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_build_days value = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_days }
                if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_days > 0 }
                    # Engine duration handles real calendar days, including
                    # month lengths; eu5ab_pl_today is only an ordering stamp.
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_construction value = 1 days = eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_days }
                }
                set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_timing_ready
                owner = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev } }
            }
        }
    }
}

        }
    }
}
